text: The name of the entity shall be MinnesotaRollerGirls, LLC, a limited liability company organized pursuant to Minnesota Statute 322B (hereafter referred to as "MNRD").

MNRD is a member owned and operated leaguecommitted to playing roller derby. The purpose of this league is to: 2.1.1Promote the sport of flat track roller derbyas per the League’s stated Mission and Core Beliefs. 2.1.2Initiate and maintain rules and regulationsfor the governing of the league. 2.1.3Make efforts to financially fund the ongoingexpenses of the league.
Membership Classifications including “Voting Members” and “Non-Voting Members” are defined in the MNRD Membership Policy.

Voting Members shallmeet on a minimum quarterly basis as determined by the Board. 3.2.1Notice of a meeting of the Voting Members shallbe sent to the Voting Members by the Board, via the electronic league message board(s), no less than seven (7) days in advance of a scheduled meeting, and no less than five (5) days in advance of a special Meeting. 3.2.2Meetings of the Voting Members are not opento the public. Portions of the Meetings may be opened to other attendees as determined by the Board. 3.2.3Meeting notes will be distributed to all VotingMembers via the electronic league message board(s) within two weeks. 3.2.4Special meetings of the Voting Members shallbe held upon call of the Board or upon the written request of not less than twenty-five percent (25%) of the Voting Members. Such meetings shall be held at such time and at such place as shall be specified in the notice of the meeting.

Each Voting Member may castone vote in any election. Voting Members will vote on significant financial decisions of the league and any decision that impacts bylaws or significant policy changes. Policy clarifications do not require league votes.

All formal leaguevotes will be done electronically via league-managed systems. The vote announcement will state the purpose and duration of the voting period. The vote ballot will be open for a period of no less than (5) days.

No vote can be countedas valid until no less than a majority (more than 50%) of Voting Members have participated. Other MNRD policies may specify higher participation. If a majority of Voting Members have not responded by the stated duration end date, the vote will remain open until a majority has participated in the vote.
New Member’seligibility requirements, membership approval and membership dismissal guidelines are outlined in the MNRD Membership Policy.
Details on how Voting Membersmay file for leave of absence, injured or inactive status are outlined in the MNRD Attendance Policy.
MNRD shall endeavor to haveCompetitive, Recreational, and Officiating Programs.
May Consist of Teams witha competitive play focus based on capacity, resources and interests.
May Consist of Teams witha recreational or developmental play focus based on capacity, resources and interests.
Consists of officials basedon capacity, resources and interests.
Teams are collections of Program Memberswith a shared goal and purpose. Teams shall be created and managed by Program Leadership.
The Boardshall be composed of the following Voting Members:

Must have been a member of MNRDfor at least one full derby season and preferably have leadership experience. If no candidate with the required full derby season membership runs, members who do not meet this requirement may be eligible. Board members are nominated by any league member, including themselves.

Each Boardmember is granted one vote per individual. The Board shall be the steering body of MNRD, and shall be responsible for managing the affairs of MNRD that are not specifically delegated to Voting Members, teams or Department Leads in these Bylaws or other governing documents or policies. 5.2.1The Board will work with the Finance Departmentto approve the annual budget. Annual budgets are created based on a three-year rolling average. If it is determined that a greater than 10% deviation is needed from an annual budget, a Voting Member vote is necessary. Any new expenses over $5,000 require a vote of Voting Members.

All Board shallhold office until their respective successors are voted in by the respective membership class on an annual basis or until their earlier resignation or removal. Although the Board term is a one-year term, the Board will work toward turnover of 50% or less each year for continuity. Board members may be required by the HR Department to step down from their position as a result of poor performance concerning their leadership duties, code of conduct or other grievance.

The Boardshall meet on a minimum quarterly basis as determined by the Board. 5.4.1Special meetings of the Board shall be heldupon call of the Board Chairperson or upon the written request of a member of the Board. Such meetings shall be held at such time and at such place as shall be specified in the notice of meeting. 5.4.2Notice of a meeting of the Board shall be sentto each Board member in writing by the Board Chairperson no less than seven (7) days in advance of a scheduled meeting, and no less than five (5) days in advance of a special meeting. 5.4.3Meetings of the Board are not open to the publicor other Members. Portions of the Meetings may be opened to other attendees as determined by the Board. Meeting notes will be distributed to Members via the electronic message board(s) within two weeks.
Representative Committee membersare nominated by any league member, including themselves.
The Representative CommitteeChair is nominated by any league member, including themselves.
The Representative Committee Chairis elected by a majority vote of the Voting Members. Elections are facilitated by the HR Department.

All RepresentativeCommittee members shall hold office until their respective successors are onboarded or until their earlier resignation or removal. Representative Committee members may be required by the HR Department to step down from their position as a result of poor performance concerning their leadership duties, code of conduct or other grievance.
DepartmentLeads are Voting Members, and hold a title Director, Manager or Coordinator ("DMC").
Department Leads are nominatedby any league member, including themselves.

Department Leads shall be appointedto their position after a one week review period. An election will be held if there are multiple candidates for an open Department Lead position. The HR Department will facilitate the election.
The Department Leadsoperate and manage specific departments within MNRD, reporting to the Board for oversight.

Significant department decisions,such as spending funds outside of annual budget allocations, must be presented to the Board for approval. Approval is granted with a majority vote of the Board. When appropriate, the Board will bring decisions to a Voting Member vote. Departments do not need to seek Board approval for day-to-day operational decisions.

All Department Leads shallhold office until their respective successors are onboarded or until their earlier resignation or removal. Department Leads may be required by the HR Department to step down from their position as a result of poor performance concerning their leadership duties, code of conduct or other grievance.

Department Leads shallmeet on a minimum quarterly basis as determined by the Board. The Board may determine the timing for meetings according to the league practice and bout schedule. 7.4.1Notice of a meeting of the Department Leadsshall be sent to each Department Lead in writing by the Board Chairperson, via Department Leads electronic message board(s), no less than seven (7) days in advance of a scheduled meeting, and no less than five (5) days in advance of a special meeting. 7.4.2.Meetings of the Department Leads are not opento the public or other Members. Portions of the Meetings may be opened to other attendees as determined by the Board.
Voting Member of MNRD for at least12 consecutive months.
Owners must be voted in as an ownerby 90% of the current MNRD owners.
The term of an owner is one year or untiltheir earlier resignation or termination.
Any bylaw or code of conduct violationby an owner will be evaluated by members of the Board and HR Department and that owner may be subject to ownership termination.
The Owners shall meet with theBoard annually. The Board may determine the timing for meetings according to the league practice and bout schedule.
